note_evidence: The track features a heavily distorted, chest-thumping 808 bass with pitch slides and a classic aggressive tamborzao rhythm starting right at 0:00.
beat_evidence: A loud, syncopated but highly predictable percussion pattern establishes a clear pulse immediately at 0:00 and maintains it until the outro.
loop_evidence: The beat completely drops out at 0:34, leaving a 5-second gap of just spoken vocals which would create a massive lull when looping.
